visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame opens with a high-definition close-up of a teal-colored fuel tank featuring the gold and white Royal Enfield logo. A person's hand reaches in to adjust a chrome mirror, reflecting the sunny outdoor environment. The setting is a spacious park with green grass and city buildings in the far distance under a bright sky. (2) The camera pans out to show the full front profile of the motorcycle, a Royal Enfield Classic 650. A man wearing a black utility vest over a white t-shirt and blue jeans stands beside it, pointing at the 648cc engine block. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting the chrome exhaust and retro design. (3) A rapid montage displays various design elements: the teardrop-shaped fuel tank with gold pinstripes, a split brown leather seat, and the long chrome exhaust pipe. The camera zooms in on the 19-inch front and 18-inch rear spoked wheels, emphasizing the vintage mechanical aesthetic against a paved road background. (4) Focus shifts to modern features integrated into the classic design, including a circular LED headlamp and a hidden USB Type-C charging port near the handlebar. The instrument cluster is shown, combining a traditional needle speedometer with a small digital screen for gear and navigation information. (5) The man is seen riding the teal motorcycle on a wide, sunny asphalt road. He wears a grey open-face helmet, a black protective jacket, and gloves. The camera uses low-angle tracking shots to capture the movement, showing the rider's relaxed posture and the bike's smooth progression past trees and fences. (6) The scene returns to the riverside park. The man stands next to the motorcycle again, gesturing with his hands as he delivers a concluding summary. He smiles broadly, conveying satisfaction. The background shows a mix of green fields and urban high-rises under a clear blue sky.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged Asian man with short black hair. He initially wears a black utility vest with a 'Royal Enfield' patch over a white t-shirt and jeans. Later, he is seen riding in a black motorcycle jacket and a grey open-face helmet.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a sunny riverside park with green grass and visible urban skylines in the background, and smooth paved roads flanked by trees and highway infrastructure.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a vibrant, upbeat electronic BGM track with a steady 4/4 beat. A male voice enters immediately with high energy and professional clarity, speaking Mandarin. A low-frequency percussive thrum of the motorcycle engine idling is audible beneath the music and speech, providing a rhythmic mechanical texture. (2) The narrator's speech rate is moderate and informative, detailing the motorcycle's technical specifications. The BGM maintains its tempo, but the engine sound fades slightly into the background. Distinct, short metallic clicks and rustles are heard during close-up shots of the bike's hardware, suggesting high-quality field recording. (3) As the visual shifts to riding, the audio profile changes significantly. A broadband wind noise floor appears, accompanied by a more prominent, rhythmic exhaust thrumming with a distinct 'thump-thump' cadence characteristic of a parallel twin. The vocal delivery becomes louder and more projected to overcome the ambient riding noise. (4) The wind noise disappears as the scene returns to a static shot. The BGM remains consistent in volume and energy, serving as a bright, optimistic bed for the final summary. The male voice adopts a friendly and persuasive tone, concluding with a slight rise in pitch for the brand mention.
